page.overview:
Who is Peter Ashdown?

Peter Danbury Ashdown is a former British Formula 1 driver. He competed in a singular F1 race, driving Alan Brown's privateer Cooper T45- in the 1959 British Grand Prix. He was the penultimate qualifier, and finished 12th in the race.
